notes.title: Realms of Wilorth: The Finish Line Is in Sight!
MAJOR Demo Update, Play the New Version Now!
notes.content:
[h3]What's new in the demo?[/h3][p]It’s been over a year since the last demo update – and in that time, [b]the game has grown tremendously[/b]. While the full version now includes all realms and bosses, the demo still focuses on the [b]Nature Realm[/b], just like before… but everything around it has leveled up.[/p][p]Here’s a breakdown of some major changes:[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔧 [b]Massive UI Overhaul[/b]
The interface has been almost completely redesigned to be cleaner, more readable, and easier to navigate. It’s still being polished, but it already feels like a huge step forward.[/p][p]⚔️ [b]Combat Feels Better Than Ever[/b]
Enemy telegraphs are now much more readable: enemies slow down before attacking, and new ground indicators make danger zones clear. The result? Combat is way more fun and satisfying (and yes — we’ll keep refining it!).[/p][p]🌀 [b]Reworked Character Abilities[/b]
All characters still use their classic tap and charge attacks, but their behaviors have been adjusted for [b]better balance and more dynamic fights[/b].[/p][p]🌄 [b]Major Visual Upgrade[/b]
Every realm now features lighting and shadows to bring environments to life — all while staying true to the retro PSX-style aesthetic.[/p][p]👾 [b]More Enemy Variety[/b]
Across all realms, enemy variety has been greatly expanded. (Note: this is mostly visible in the full version, we felt that the Nature Realm had enough enemy variety)[/p][hr][/hr][p]Honestly, there have been [b]so many changes over the past year[/b], I’ve probably forgotten more than half of them… but I hope you’ll feel the difference the moment you jump in.[/p][p]If you played the old demo — [b]this is a whole new experience[/b]. And if you’re new — there’s never been a better time to try it.

Thanks for your support, as always!

P.S. I'll be sharing a [b]pre-release roadmap[/b] in the next few days, so you can see exactly what we’re working on as we get closer to release. Stay tuned! 😊[/p]

notes.title: Updated demo coming soon!
notes.content:
[p]After a year of hard work, we've completely refreshed our game's presentation on Steam. New screenshots, new description, new assets… and this is just the beginning![/p][p]Very soon, we'll be releasing a new version of the demo, including all the changes, improvements, and new content we've developed over the past year.
Thanks for your support, and stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Realms of Wilorth Demo Launch!
notes.content:
Announcement: Realms of Wilorth Demo Now Available! 

Greetings, lost souls!

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for "Realms of Wilorth" is finally here, beckoning brave souls like yourself to embark on an unforgettable journey! 

 [b]Dive into a retro-styled action roguelite[/b] adventure where you guide the souls of sacrificed warriors across five elemental-themed realms in search of coveted seeds of power.

 [b]Discover Elemental Combat:[/b] Unleash the power of elemental combat, where each element holds its own strengths and weaknesses. Will you wield nature's slowing powers, fire's burning fury, or darkness's life-stealing grasp? The choice is yours to make.

[b]Choose Your Hero:[/b] Play as the resilient Knight, the deadly Mage, or the nimble Rogue, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Will you rely on defense, magic, or agility to conquer the realms?

[b]Procedural Challenges Await:[/b] With every level gained, choose game-changing perks to aid you in your quest. Explore procedurally generated realms, each offering new challenges and opportunities for discovery.

[b]Face the Guardians:[/b] Will you challenge the realm guardians to retrieve the seeds of power, or delve into treacherous dungeons to confront the dragons and claim valuable golden seeds? The choice is yours, and the fate of Wilorth hangs in the balance.

 [b]Download the Demo:[/b] Head to our Steam store page now to download the demo for free! Experience a taste of the retro feel that awaits in "Realms of Wilorth."

Join us on this epic quest, and together, let's uncover the secrets of the realms!

Happy Wilorth-ing!

Reckless Monster Studio.
